_readme:
Recommendations from employers, colleagues, clients and the end users of your systems. Each entry can point at what it is about: `experience` takes an id from experience.json ("youcode", "ynnovision") and `project` an id from projects.json ("usapp", "jms-e-talyer"). Linked recommendations also show on that project and that role. `relationship` is one of employer, colleague, client, end-user. `photo` must exist under ./public or initials show instead. Add `sourceHref` (for example the LinkedIn recommendation) wherever one exists. The page and its nav link hide themselves while `items` is empty. Copy this shape:

{
  "id": "maria-santos-youcode",
  "name": "Maria Santos",
  "role": "Chief Technology Officer",
  "organization": "YouCode Technologies",
  "relationship": "employer",
  "quote": "...",
  "date": "Sep 2026",
  "photo": "/recommendations/maria-santos.webp",
  "sourceHref": "https://www.linkedin.com/in/...",
  "experience": "youcode",
  "project": "usapp"
}
label: recommendations
heading: In other people's words.
blurb: What employers, colleagues, clients and the people using these systems say about working with me.
